Summary: Racial division, historic injustice, and identity politics strain the body of Christ.
BiblicalPrinciples: One blood, one image, one body; in Christ there is neither Jew nor Greek; reconciliation is the Gospel's fruit.
BiblicalResponse: Build real multiethnic fellowship; listen before lecturing; repent of partiality; pursue justice without adopting ideologies that deny grace.
Pitfalls: Denying real wounds; reducing reconciliation to slogans; letting secular frameworks replace biblical unity.
